name: easyfact-africa
description: EasyFact Africa - Enterprise Financial & Invoicing Platform

scripts.build: node -e "const fs=require('fs'); if(!fs.existsSync('public')) fs.mkdirSync('public'); ['index.html','styles.css','app.js','easyfact_logo.png','easyfact_icon.png','easyfact_hero.png'].forEach(f => { if(fs.existsSync(f)) fs.copyFileSync(f, 'public/' + f); });" && cd server && npm install --include=dev && npm run build
